prompt.label: What to do with it
prompt.help: Add: Adds the file’s item to this site. Replace: Writes the file’s copy over this site’s. Pages, layouts and emails get it as a new version. Keep both: Adds the file’s copy beside this site’s, under a new ID and address. Skip: Leaves this site’s item as it is. Merge: Keeps this site’s values and fills in what it has not set; choose key by key.
